## Sophia modules (sophia.html) · 3 passages

- **hillary**: This friendship is a separate documented thread from either man's Epstein exposure. No documented photo has surfaced showing Trump, Epstein, and (Bill) Clinton together in the same frame — what exists are three overlapping pairwise relationships (Trump-Epstein, Clinton-Epstein, Trump-Clinton), not one three-way connection. A December 2025 document release from Epstein's own estate did include images of both Trump and Bill Clinton (separately) alongside Epstein and Maxwell, among many other names (Bill Gates, Woody Allen, Steve Bannon) — none of the released photos depict wrongdoing, per the reporting on that release itself. Hillary Clinton does not appear in this Epstein-photo thread at all; her own, separate Epstein-related record is covered in era #16.
- **ivanka**: Rick Gates, deputy chairman of the inaugural committee, emailed Ivanka Trump directly stating the hotel's price "seems quite high compared to other properties" and that he was concerned about media scrutiny of a nonprofit paying the president's own hotel a large fee. [cite:nbc_inaugural_dc_suit]
- **kushnerbio**: The Senate Intelligence Committee's leaders jointly referred Kushner, Donald Trump Jr., Steve Bannon, Erik Prince, and Sam Clovis to federal prosecutors over suspected misleading testimony, reportedly based on contradictions with aide Richard Gates' account. No indictment or public resolution regarding Kushner specifically was located in this research. A separate July 2019 House Judiciary vote (21-12) authorized, but per this research was not shown to have been enforced against, a subpoena for Kushner as part of a broader obstruction inquiry.

- **ep_OPERATIONS_v1.md**: **The subpoena asymmetry, answered precisely.** - **What Congress did:** it can and did compel testimony. Bill and Hillary Clinton were deposed (Feb 2026); Gates, Lutnick, Kellen, Groff and Noel gave transcribed interviews. - **What no one did:** no record shows a **phone-records or grand-jury subpoena** for any named associate. That takes a predicated criminal investigation, which DOJ declined in July 2025. - **The record on the drug case:** a predicated investigation *did* exist. The DEA's 2015 Chain Reaction case named 15 targets, and none was charged. - **What it means:** an ordinary suspect's phone is subpoenaed because a case is opened, and here the case was opened, then dropped without explanation. The book asks the DEA's own six unanswered questions (Wyden, 25 Feb 2026).
